semantics.intervention: Only native KV merge-head identity changes; original candidate/budget/classification/merger preserved.
semantics.random_ranking: Private Python random.Random seeded by SHA256([head_seed, global, layers, KV heads, batch]) rather than global generation RNG. One model-level without-replacement ranking reused across prompts/tasks.
semantics.quota: Global count matches native ceil(layers*KV_heads*merge_ratio), not a per-layer quota.
semantics.hybrid: Native mask layout [layers,batch,KV_heads]; captures native calibrated classes before release and all per-head budgets/candidates. Different selected head identities may change actual removed-token totals under heterogeneous budgets.
semantics.snap: Native mask layout [batch,layers,KV_heads]; strict baseline/candidate eligibility, effective merge work and cache coverage checks remain intact.
semantics.effective_work_note: Reference selectors are copied exactly. The reference worker additionally enforces that every selected head really performed a shortening merge; the image runtime must retain that completion gate.
semantics.excluded: random token eviction, random static/dynamic classification, random head budgets and random_layer_matched are not the image ablation.
